name: Spacer spool and riser spool
function: A flanged spool inserted in the stack to add height or to move a connection clear of another component, for example to lift the goat head above the wing valve actuators.

tabs.overview: Same bore as the stack; flanged both ends. Length is chosen at rig-up to suit the iron run and the equipment that will land on the tree.
tabs.engineering: API 6A pressure-containing spool rated with the stack.
tabs.safety: Every added spool adds two ring-gasket connections and two test points.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
